paragraphs.ref: text:Day 6 · Travel to Monteverde the scenic way, by taxi-boat-taxi: a boat ride across peaceful Lake Arenal, with views of the volcano, to the small town of Río Chiquito, then on by road. Monteverde has a rural, small-town feel, and Santa Elena is its eco-tourism hub. In the heart of the Monteverde Cloud Forest, Selvatura’s zip lines and hanging bridges take you deep into the primary cloud forest. Overnight at Hotel Montaña Monteverde. (B)

provenance.rationale: The route heading condenses the Day 6 journey across Lake Arenal to Monteverde.

paragraphs.ref: text:Day 4 · A visit to the Maleku Indigenous Reserve in northern Costa Rica, to learn how the community lives today and how it has rescued its traditions. Welcomed by the locals at Tonjibe Palenque, walk through the village to learn about their burial customs, the palenques built in ancient times, the crafts that support the community, the use of cacao in their agriculture and their traditional clothing, then follow a 600-metre forest path to discover the medicinal plants and trees used by their ancestors. Continue to the northern lowlands and La Fortuna, at the foot of Arenal Volcano, and relax in the area’s hot springs. Overnight at Arenal Paraíso Resort & Spa. (B)

provenance.rationale: Place label combines the two linked geographical names in the approved Day 4 paragraph.
